items.question: What is Bioscience Mastery?
items.answer: Bioscience Mastery is an independent biotechnology and life sciences education platform in development for Indian students. GAT-B preparation is our first focus, with other examination courses planned for later.

items.question: Can I enroll in GAT-B right now?
items.answer: Not yet. You can explore our course information today. Enrollment, lessons, and assessments will become available in later releases once they have been implemented and reviewed. No launch date or price has been announced.

items.question: Will learning be available in Hindi?
items.answer: Yes. English and Hindi learning content is planned. The public website is already available in both languages; course translations will be reviewed for scientific accuracy before publication.

items.question: Will there be free and premium content?
items.answer: Both free resources and premium learning are planned. Pricing and access details will be published before enrollment opens. This website does not currently accept payments.

items.question: How do Coming Soon notifications work?
items.answer: Email launch alerts are not enabled yet, and the website is not collecting email addresses. A later release will add consent-based subscriptions, confirmation, and unsubscribe controls.

items.question: Is this an official examination website?
items.answer: No. Bioscience Mastery is an independent education platform and does not claim affiliation with any university or examination authority. Important examination information will only be published after verification.
